_comment: Cameras-and-effects cause lane (tb/cause-camfx, owner 1 Nov: bring every catalogue item to a mapped High 7.0+ by fixing shared causes). One block per sub-cause, each its own flag, every flag OFF until GPU judged. Presentation only and local to each peer: no hit test, timing, catch maths or save state reads any of it. scripts/vfx/camfx.gd reads this file; a block whose `enabled` is not true reads as empty and callers draw exactly as before.

catch_orb._why: Judges 1 Nov and GPU item scores (P2-060 6.06, P2-059 5.21, P2-113): 'flat glow disc, no physical orb' -- the camera-facing halo around the resting orb fills a third of the resolve close-up as a flat yellow bubble with an over-bright white ball inside. When enabled: the authored Meshy capture orb (teal and cream shell, brass band, lit button; already in the repo, assets/props/meshy-1020) replaces the flat sphere; the halo is drawn only in flight and smaller; at hang, rest and seal there is no disc at all, so the orb's own shading carries it; a soft contact shadow sits it on the ground; landing and each shake kick a little dust and grit (the fights' contact_burst, small) instead of the flat gold flash disc; each shake squashes and hops the shell. The verdict flashes (catching.json vfx) are scaled by verdict_flash_scale so the seal no longer veils the orb. scripts/combat/orb.gd, combat_manager.gd _catch_flash.

flame._why: Judges 1 Nov: 'flat yellow cone flame' (P2-035 bonfire_fire, every authored camp fire through props.gd glow:"campfire"). Earlier rounds that made the same cone translucent or added uniform-alpha cards were judged 'hard-edged ... cut from cardboard': a uniform alpha never softens a polygon edge. When enabled, ignite() hides the Bonfire's Fire cone and stands a procedural flame in its footprint instead: two camera-facing (Y-locked) quads with a feathered, noise-licked teardrop mask that sways and flickers (shaders/camfx_flame.gdshader), orange edges to a pale-gold core, no texture, no particles, so it reads the same on Compatibility and Forward+ and costs two quads per fire. The CampfireGlow halo card is dropped (the flame carries its own soft edge); light, embers and smoke unchanged. scripts/world/campfire_glow.gd ignite(), scripts/vfx/camfx.gd add_flame().

impact_fx._why: Judges 1 Nov: 'flat magenta telegraph rings and slabs' and P2-063 'bright impact effects obscure creatures': a landed blow reads as a flat additive disc over the struck body. When enabled every landed blow (quick and charged) also leaves physical objects at the struck creature's feet: lit stone chips thrown up that tumble, bounce once and settle (none for water and air blows); on a charged blow a jagged ground crack (not for water, air or ice) that glows briefly for electric and fire; and on an electric blow three jagged lightning arcs from the body to the ground for a third of a second. The flat flash disc shrinks to flash_scale. Meshes and one shader on the physics clock; no particles, no shadows. scripts/vfx/camfx_impact.gd, combat_manager.gd _flash_host_impact.

fight_fade._why: Judges 1 Nov: 'camera inside canopy, fight lost' (Stormwood fights i11/i13/i15) and Fenn's near-black dialogue frame (P2-084: the push-in lens stands in a scattered trunk). camera.json occlusion_fade (tb/vis-storm-cams, GPU batch 5) fades what stands between the FOLLOWED body and the lens; in a fight the followed body is the piloted creature, so canopy over the opponent, and a crown the lens sits inside above the ally, stayed. When enabled this turns the same fade on for fight and conversation cameras even if occlusion_fade is off, and also fades along the opponent's (fight) and speaker's (conversation) chest-to-lens line. include_shadowless also fades tall foliage cards that cast no shadow (canopy leaf cards), which the base fade skips as effect cards; skinned bodies, grass under min_height_m and effects stay. Arm length and stands unchanged. scripts/player/camera_rig.gd _fade_occluders.
